turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How is your day going at the clinic in Phoenix?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! It's going well, thank you. The outpatient clinic has been quite busy today, but I've got plenty of energy since I'm completely recovered from that flu.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm so glad to hear you're feeling back to one hundred percent. Did you do anything special to kickstart your morning today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes! I decided to make a frothed milk beverage with whisked green tea powder before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds lovely! Did you make that at home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! It was nice to sit down and enjoy it. I didn't even use my roommate's new espresso machine, just whisked the green tea manually.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: How is your roommate liking that espresso machine, by the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She absolutely loves it. She's been using it every single day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great! Do you have any plans for your sourdough baking or salsa dancing this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm planning to go salsa dancing tomorrow night. I might also prep some sourdough tonight so I can bake tomorrow.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a fun and active weekend. Are you seeing Tom?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, Tom is coming with me to salsa dancing tomorrow. We're both really looking forward to it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect date. I hope you both have a fantastic time!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! I appreciate it. I should get back to my shift now, but I'll check in with you later.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a great rest of your shift at the clinic! Talk to you soon.

first_try_failures: invention: Tom does not help with the sourdough baking process because he lacks patience for it, but he enjoys eating the finished product.
